title: Choose from several labels
summary: COBOL: Choose from several labels. Use R as the light value.
introduction: EVALUATE selects steps by matching a value. WHEN OTHER is a fallback.
learningObjectives: Choose from several labels with COBOL
Use R as the light value

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Choose from several labels
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.

01 LIGHT PIC X VALUE "G".
procedure division.
EVALUATE LIGHT
 WHEN "R" DISPLAY "Stop"
 WHEN "G" DISPLAY "Go"
 WHEN OTHER DISPLAY "Wait"
END-EVALUATE
stop run.

blocks.text: The G value matches the second WHEN branch, which displays Go.
Use R as the light value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a picture large enough for each label.
